title: Second Address
warm:
Second address arrived at marble-dawn like a paper trail with manners—inland coordinates Rhea Quinn's burned log ash had half-named, Marcus Pell's traveling language had half-denied, and Detective Imani Brooks would call a search map if [player_name] widened it. Early thirties, she/her, across-the-hall soft alibi standing over printouts on Nolan Greer's wine-ringed marble. Crownspire's wind sheer threw city light as accusation. Vivienne's four fates flared without settling: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging.

"This is not a body," Nolan said. Mid-forties, finance and tech holding, cufflinks still for once. Brutal charm tired. "It is a second door inland. Soft still means we do not invent which fate walked through it. Soft also means you choose whether Crownspire stays the only name on the map."

[player_name] traced the address with a fingertip that still smelled faintly of hangar fuel and unused perfume twin. Calendar cadence weekly to monthly to gone lived beside inland paper like cousins. Hope and dread shared the wine ring. Elevator chime trembled downstairs. Black car at the curb might already know the route.

Brooks's homicide interest rose without requiring a corpse on the table. Pell would call widening the map a fire hazard. Rhea's slate had already paid ash for thinner truth. Across the hall, [player_name]'s own apartment waited with clearer conscience and colder sheets.

"Widen the search," Nolan offered, almost kind, "and Layer 8 spends you into geography Brooks can subpoena. Or speak the night-truth you still withhold—bring the gap into bed before the map owns the morning. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend soft into sharper paper."

She catalogued dawn the way Brooks would: address, dates, methods, no settled fate. Soft alibi had fingerprints and a second door. Choice labels waited as consequence: widen the search map inland, or night-truth first while marble still held their wine rings.

Crownspire held its hush. Perfume from the master bath. Badge rewrite waiting in lobby fluorescent. [player_name] felt the second address watching her back as surely as Nolan did, and understood that reading it had already changed which soft she could still claim.

Rain-money cologne. Perfume twin memory on her wrist. Brooks's colder file in her bloodstream without a corpse. Nipples tight under silk for reasons that were not pure fear.

"Widen the map," he murmured against her ear, thumb counting ribs, "or speak the night-truth into bed before geography owns us. Both leave you wet. Neither puts my wife in a box."

Crime plot; intimacy-forward heat, never gore. Four fates open. Her cunt clenched around unfinished choice. Cufflink flash low and filthy. Mid-want ending first—climax belonging to widen or speak.

She arched, thighs tight. Elevator chime through teeth. Wine-ringed marble. Black car curb-idle. Romance locked on Nolan alone. Unfinished on purpose while homicide interest rose without naming a body. Soft alibi heat ended on the hook of Layer 8 verbs.
